title: Two-dimensional worker spec: harness × model/effort in runners.toml
description:
Extend the routing config so each role/tier is specified along two explicit dimensions instead of raw args: kind (the harness dimension herdr already names: claude, codex, pi, ...) plus structured 'model' and optional 'effort' fields (e.g. model="opus" effort="high"; model="gpt-5.6-luna" effort="max"). The spawner compiles model/effort to the kind's native argv (claude: --model + its effort mechanism; codex: -m + reasoning-effort flag; pi: its <provider>/<model>:<effort> syntax which is cross-provider — see .tick/config.md 'Pi Orchestrator' for real examples). 'args' stays as an escape hatch appended after compiled flags.

The matrix is sparse: claude kind accepts only claude-family models, codex only its OpenAI models, pi accepts cross-provider IDs. Document the compatibility rule per kind in herdr-kinds.md (new translation-table section: model/effort spec -> native argv, plus which model families the kind accepts) and state the fail-closed rule: an impossible cell (e.g. kind=claude model=gpt-*) is a config error the orchestrator must refuse at spawn time with a clear message, never silently reroute.

Update skills/ticks/references/runners-config.md + runners-config.schema.json: add model/effort to role and tier tables (tiers become model/effort pairs in examples), keep additionalProperties:false, keep all worked examples valid, add a pi cross-provider example cell, and add negative tests: impossible cell documented as spawn-time (not schema-time) failure, plus schema rejection of malformed effort values. Re-validate all examples against the schema and record evidence.

Files owned: runners-config.md, runners-config.schema.json, herdr-kinds.md. Do not edit herdr-runner.md except, if strictly needed, one sentence pointing at the new translation section.
acceptance_criteria: Schema validates model/effort on roles and tiers; all worked examples (incl. a pi cross-provider one) validate; herdr-kinds.md carries the per-kind translation + compatibility table and the fail-closed rule; validation evidence recorded
closed_reason: Completed: two-dimensional worker spec — model/effort fields on orchestrator/roles/tiers, per-kind translation+compatibility table (flags verified against real CLIs; codex effort via -c model_reasoning_effort), fail-closed spawn rule, pi cross-provider example; 5/5 examples + 9 negative cases validated
